mentions.name: sc-filter-builder
mentions.description: A client-side-only web tool for building custom image filters and batch-applying them to multiple images, built on the author's canvas library's filter engine inspired by SVG chainable filters.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a client-side-only web page that will (eventually) allow users to build their own image filter and batch-apply it to a bunch of images.
